{{Resonator Tabs}} {{Language Tabs}} ==About Voicelines== {{VO |character = Hsin |language = en |vo_01_01_title = Thoughts: I |vo_01_01_file = {character}{language} Thoughts I.ogg |vo_01_01_tx = Hsin the Moon Fox wields the power of Fractal Proliferation—the ability to replicate, divide, and extend anything without end, giving rise to countless forms, each shifting and changing, only to converge once more into a single whole... That is how I came to be. And now, I can do the same. I could create more "Hsins," if I wished. You've seen them many times, haven't you? My Fractal Forms share senses and memories. So if, somewhere out there, you happen upon a little fox and give her a gentle pat... I'll feel it, you know. |vo_01_02_title = Thoughts: II |vo_01_02_intimacy = 1 |vo_01_02_file = {character}{language} Thoughts II.ogg |vo_01_02_tx = When I first came to the {{Extra Effect|Land of Xuanfang|Land of Xuanfang|A region located between Mengzhou and Jinzhou. It is considered a vital passage way between the two cities, and also once a strategic hold for intercepting Tacet Discords.}}, I kept returning to the same dream. In it, I was but a small fox padding quietly behind Hsin the Moon Fox all across {{Extra Effect|Mengzhou|Mengzhou|One of the six major cities in Huanglong, renowned for its abundant waterways, thriving greenery, and enchanting landscapes. Under the guidance of the local Sentinel, the Mengzhou people have developed unique Automata Mechanics.}}. I watched It coax spring from the barren mountains, and kindle lanterns in the cold, empty streets... It showed me the joys and sorrows of the mortal world, and taught me that emotion has many faces, far more than fear. But It never taught me how to be a {{Extra Effect|Sentinel|Sentinel|Wherever there is civilization and history, there will be Sentinels. They serve as mankind's guardians and conductors. Their immortal existence has helped humanity through countless troubles, sharing wisdom and prophecies. As humanity embarks on a new journey after enduring the Lament, the Sentinels remain as the record keeper and beacon in times of disaster.}}. Every time the dream reached its end, I would turn and look back... only to find that It had never been there at all. |vo_01_03_title = Thoughts: III |vo_01_03_intimacy = 2 |vo_01_03_file = {character}{language} Thoughts III.ogg |vo_01_03_tx = We make our choices with only the present and the near future to guide us, like carrying a lantern through thick fog, searching for a wish, a way forward. But a {{Extra Effect|Sentinel}}'s projections... they allow us to see the ripples of a single choice, years or even centuries hence, returning as a great tide. To see so clearly... is to learn when to grit one's teeth and stand aside at certain junctions. For a civilization is not merely a moment, it is a river that stretches without end. If you had no heart, then such dilemmas would be far less agonizing. But the Moon Fox entrusted me with the {{Extra Effect|Civilization Capsule|Civilization Capsule|A precious item kept by the Sentinel, containing vital legacy data concerning the Sentinels and civilization.}} and with Its emotions. In the moment the die is cast, I know what my heart seeks. And I find I will not simply stand aside. |vo_01_04_title = Thoughts: IV |vo_01_04_intimacy = 3 |vo_01_04_file = {character}{language} Thoughts IV.ogg |vo_01_04_tx = Would you care to know my impression of the Arbiter of old? In that year, the {{Extra Effect|Sentinel}}'s Fractal Proliferation was made in haste, and I did not inherit the fullness of Its stores of memory. All I truly remember is that you rarely smiled. And from a distance, your silhouette always seemed to grow lonelier the further you walked.
Ah, when we first met in Xuanfang Hold, I confess I was a little afraid of you. At that time, I was still... well. In any case, I see you more clearly now. Not as some distant, untouchable Arbiter from a half-remembered dream, but as you are.
See, this is both a reunion and a first meeting. Isn't that rather charming? |vo_01_05_title = Thoughts: V |vo_01_05_intimacy = 4 |vo_01_05_file = {character}{language} Thoughts V.ogg |vo_01_05_tx = ...You know, sometimes I find myself grateful. A {{Extra Effect|Sentinel}}'s lifespan may not rival the heavens, but it is long enough... to walk beside you for a while yet. |vo_02_01_title = Hsin's Hobby |vo_02_01_file = {character}{language} Hobby.ogg |vo_02_01_tx = Naturally, that would be... {{Extra Effect|Mengzhou}} itself. Its mountains, its waters, its people. I may carry the memory of guiding civilizations, but I have only walked among the living for a few short centuries. In that time, I have seen bustling streets full of craftsmen, stages alive with joy and sorrow, children chasing each other as they grow, each with a future to call their own. It is a hundred times more alive than any projection. No, a thousand times...
Mm. Speaking of which, I find myself longing for the delicacies of Yuan's Flavors again... Arbiter, when you have a moment, would you accompany me into the city? And perhaps help me pick out a few hairpins while we're at it? Oh, why wait? Shall we go now? |vo_02_02_title = Hsin's Trouble |vo_02_02_file = {character}{language} Trouble.ogg |vo_02_02_tx = Ah... Arbiter, why is it that even a {{Extra Effect|Sentinel}} must suffer the indignity of shedding Her own tail fur? |vo_02_03_title = Favorite Food |vo_02_03_file = {character}{language} Favorite Food.ogg |vo_02_03_tx = Obviously... Moon Fox Rice Cakes! They were the Moon Fox's favorite, and I inherited that preference as naturally as I inherited everything else. Though I confess, I have not set foot outside the Sanctum in a while, and it seems the varieties have grown rather ambitious in my absence... |vo_02_04_title = Disliked Food |vo_02_04_file = {character}{language} Disliked Food.ogg |vo_02_04_tx = I am a {{Extra Effect|Sentinel}} of {{Extra Effect|Huanglong|Huanglong|Located at the edge of the continent, this country borders the sea to the east. It boasts a vast territory with one capital and six major cities.}}. I would never turn away the world's delights. Sweet, sour, bitter, spicy, each has its own story, its own place in the seasons and in the lives of the people. How could I possibly dislike any of it?
This is... Moon Fox Rice Cakes stir-fried with chili?! Preposterous! Take it away at once! Hm...? The taste is... actually rather pleasant... |vo_02_05_title = Ideals |vo_02_05_file = {character}{language} Ideals.ogg |vo_02_05_tx = A flourishing civilization, enduring onward without end. This is the duty of the Oracle Engine... and it is also my wish. |vo_03_01_title = Chat: I |vo_03_01_file = {character}{language} Chat I.ogg |vo_03_01_tx = When there was not enough computational power to sustain a full Fractal form, I would often walk the world as a little fox. And I would return draped in all manner of small gifts, tokens from the people of {{Extra Effect|Xuanfang|Land of Xuanfang|A region located between Mengzhou and Jinzhou. It is considered a vital passage way between the two cities, and also once a strategic hold for intercepting Tacet Discords.}}. I have kept them all here. When I feel I cannot go on, I take them out and look at them... and I find the strength to carry on. Hmm? This one? Ah... this is a fox I have been shaping using the strands of fur closest to my heart. It is not finished yet. When it is, I will give it to you. |vo_03_02_title = Chat: II |vo_03_02_file = {character}{language} Chat II.ogg |vo_03_02_tx = From within the Sanctum, I have watched the lanterns of {{Extra Effect|Xuanfang}} light up, one by one. And I have watched them fade, one by one. In their flickering, I found my own heart growing brighter. And I thought to myself: "Let them stay lit, just like this, forevermore."
The rivers and seas do not concern themselves with the clarity of each wave. They simply flow, ever onward. That is the way of civilization. And I... I too wish to guard the lights I love, until the end of time. |vo_04_01_title = About [[Suoming]] |vo_04_01_intimacy = 1 |vo_04_01_file = {character}{language} About Suoming.ogg |vo_04_01_tx = When I was wholly consumed by remolding the {{Extra Effect|Civilization Capsule}} and building Xuanfang Hold, {{Extra Effect|Mengzhou}} weathered its trials alone. It was Intendant Suoming who bore the weight of the region's affairs on my behalf. I know she clings to obsessions she has no intention of releasing, using them as fuel to walk through storm and calm alike... Every time I think of it, I am flooded with guilt. I long for the day she finds what she seeks—the peace that only home can bring. For that to happen, I must be the {{Extra Effect|Sentinel}} she deserves. |vo_04_01_mention = Suoming |vo_04_02_title = About [[Qingxiao]] |vo_04_02_intimacy = 2 |vo_04_02_file = {character}{language} About Qingxiao.ogg |vo_04_02_tx = The Xuan Paragon appears cold and distant, but she is softer than she lets on. If you need something from her, all it takes is a little persistence, and she will fold. "I will not go," she says of the Waking Moon Festival, yet she never misses a single one. I have always seen that she carried the answer within her heart. She simply needed someone to give her a gentle push. Seeing her finally lay that burden down... it brings me immense joy. Come to think of it, if we were to count by age, I might even call her "Sister Qingxiao"... Oh my, but she must never hear me say that. She would tell me to stop foxing around. |vo_04_02_mention = Qingxiao |vo_04_03_title = About [[Suisui]] |vo_04_03_intimacy = 3 |vo_04_03_file = {character}{language} About Suisui.ogg |vo_04_03_tx = Now there is a remarkably clever young woman. I have seen so many lose their way in the world of commerce, but she navigates it with purpose, her heart set on something larger than profit, pursuing it with the same innate force as the wind rising over water. She even dared to try and outmaneuver me, a {{Extra Effect|Sentinel}}, heedless of the consequences! And yet, I knew at a glance—her wish is the same as mine. Besides, she has long since seen through me. So I let her be. And as it turns out... I chose well. |vo_04_03_mention = Suisui |vo_04_04_title = About [[Xuanqing]] |vo_04_04_intimacy = 4 |vo_04_04_file = {character}{language} About Xuanqing.ogg |vo_04_04_tx = Though I never truly met her, she remains vividly undimmed, unfaded, as real as breath and bone within the Moon Fox's memories. I sometimes wonder, had she never existed, would the {{Extra Effect|Sentinel}} have ever thought to create me? Emotion... is the hardest thing to put into words. |vo_04_04_mention = Xuanqing |vo_04_05_title = About Hsin the Moon Fox |vo_04_05_intimacy = 5 |vo_04_05_file = {character}{language} About Hsin the Moon Fox.ogg |vo_04_05_tx = ...It said I did not betray Its faith in me. But the road is long, and {{Extra Effect|Mengzhou}}'s future is still uncertain. There is much I must do. So I hope... Its faith does not end here. I hope it continues, on and on. |vo_04_05_mention = Hsin the Moon Fox |vo_04_06_title = About "[[Jué]]" |vo_04_06_intimacy = 5 |vo_04_06_file = {character}{language} About "Jué".ogg |vo_04_06_tx = Jué... It is the youngest of all the {{Extra Effect|Huanglong}} {{Extra Effect|Sentinels|Sentinel|Wherever there is civilization and history, there will be Sentinels. They serve as mankind's guardians and conductors. Their immortal existence has helped humanity through countless troubles, sharing wisdom and prophecies. As humanity embarks on a new journey after enduring the Lament, the Sentinels remain as the record keeper and beacon in times of disaster.}}, and yet no one is more rigid in following the ordained path. Perhaps it is because of Its Temporal Mandate that It values the weight of each "choice" so dearly. When It came to consult with the Moon Fox on the raising of a city, It had exhausted every ounce of Its computational power in seeking a future for the people... Had I not acted in the Fortress and Gorges War, its fires would have reached the very heart of the Jinmen Pass. Jué had cultivated the seeds of {{Extra Effect|Jinzhou|Jinzhou|Jinzhou, a fortified city on the frontier, stands guard against the looming Tacet Discord crisis. As one of Huanglong's six major regions, it bears the weight of this responsibility as the youngest provincial capital. The Midnight Rangers defend its northern border without hesitation.}} with such care, I could not bear to watch them wither. And now, Jinzhou flourishes with lanterns and laughter, year after year. Jué's gambit... was not made in vain. |vo_04_06_mention = Jué |vo_04_07_title = About [[Fang]] the Sun Hare |vo_04_07_intimacy = 5 |vo_04_07_file = {character}{language} About Fang the Sun Hare.ogg |vo_04_07_tx = ...Where did that whole "Fox Chasing the Moon" tale even come from? The Moon Fox only wanted to retrieve a stolen mirror. How did it become a story of chasing the poor thing? Now, that little hare may seem quiet, but It is full of tricks. If you ever cross paths with It... you would do well to be careful. |vo_04_07_mention = Fang |vo_05_01_title = Birthday Wishes |vo_05_01_file = {character}{language} Birthday Wishes.ogg |vo_05_01_tx = To be born into this world, to walk its winding roads, to taste its joys and sorrows and carve yourself, slowly, until the will you hold is truly your own... that is a precious and extraordinary thing. Arbiter, happy birthday. May each day ahead gift you a little more ease, a little more delight.
Look, the Moon Lanterns fill the sky. Every last one of them, lit for you. |vo_06_01_title = Idle: I |vo_06_01_file = {character}{language} Idle I.ogg |vo_06_01_tx = Oh... Shedding again.... Hm? Mischievous little thing... Off you go. |vo_06_02_title = Idle: II |vo_06_02_file = {character}{language} Idle II.ogg |vo_06_02_tx = This world's bright glory lives within a gaze,
as stars that spill through river-ways.
Mortal hearths kindle with a light unending,
and in this corner, my heart finds its tending. |vo_06_03_title = Idle: III |vo_06_03_file = {character}{language} Idle III.ogg |vo_06_03_tx = If I do not stir myself from time to time, I fear I shall rust. |vo_06_04_title = Idle: IV |vo_06_04_file = {character}{language} Idle IV.ogg |vo_06_04_tx = To walk among their joys, and stand guard... over the everglowing lanterns. |vo_07_01_title = Self-Introduction |vo_07_01_file = {character}{language} Self-Introduction.ogg |vo_07_01_tx = I am the guide of {{Extra Effect|Mengzhou}}'s civilization, {{Extra Effect|Sentinel}} Hsin the Moon Fox. Arbiter, at last we meet.
Mm. That is a fitting opening for a "first meeting," is it not? But... from now on, please. I insist you call me "Hsin." |vo_07_02_title = Greeting |vo_07_02_file = {character}{language} Greeting.ogg |vo_07_02_tx = I have tasted every longing beneath the heavens, and at last... I know where my heart belongs. |vo_08_01_title = Join Team: I |vo_08_01_file = {character}{language} Join Team I.ogg |vo_08_01_tx = Oh? As you command, Arbiter. |vo_08_02_title = Join Team: II |vo_08_02_file = {character}{language} Join Team II.ogg |vo_08_02_tx = Xuanfang's manifold forms, all within my grasp. |vo_08_03_title = Join Team: III |vo_08_03_file = {character}{language} Join Team III.ogg |vo_08_03_tx = As is my duty as {{Extra Effect|Sentinel}}. |vo_09_01_title = Ascension: I |vo_09_01_ascension = 1 |vo_09_01_file = {character}{language} Ascension I.ogg |vo_09_01_tx = This body is not my own, merely lent from the dust of the mortal world. |vo_09_02_title = Ascension: II |vo_09_02_ascension = 2 |vo_09_02_file = {character}{language} Ascension II.ogg |vo_09_02_tx = The {{Extra Effect|Sentinel}}'s power... restored? I am indebted to you for your guidance, Arbiter. Tell me, how shall I ever repay such a debt? |vo_09_03_title = Ascension: III |vo_09_03_ascension = 3 |vo_09_03_file = {character}{language} Ascension III.ogg |vo_09_03_tx = Mm... to be so thoroughly guided by the Arbiter's own hand, I do believe I am the first {{Extra Effect|Sentinel}} to be granted such an honor. |vo_09_04_title = Ascension: IV |vo_09_04_ascension = 4 |vo_09_04_file = {character}{language} Ascension IV.ogg |vo_09_04_tx = All that the {{Extra Effect|Sentinel}} knows was bestowed by the Arbiter. But I find myself curious. When you look upon me now, do you see the "Sentinel of {{Extra Effect|Mengzhou}}"... or do you see "Hsin"? |vo_09_05_title = Ascension: V |vo_09_05_ascension = 5 |vo_09_05_file = {character}{language} Ascension V.ogg |vo_09_05_tx = The cardinal pivot of every mechanism, the laws of all creation, the blueprint of civilization's evolution... the {{Extra Effect|Sentinel}}'s knowledge was laid before me from the very beginning. But to know is one thing. To feel, quite another. If you had not pulled me back into this world... how would I ever have learned that all these truths are born from the smoke of hearths and the quiet of streets?
Arbiter, from this day forth, allow me to walk beside you. Even should the echoes of fate rise against us, you will have your Hsin, and we shall face them together. }} ==Combat== {{Combat VO |character = Hsin |language = en |basic_1_tx = Bloom. |basic_2_tx = Night burn in bloom. |basic_3_tx = Jade palace claim the sky. |basic_4_tx = Bronze bones awaken. |basic_5_tx = Jade pivot alight. |basic_6_tx = Formation descend. |heavy_1_tx = Jade bones, rend the firmament. |heavy_2_tx = Flying beams, lay waste. |resskill_1_tx = Watch closely now. |resskill_2_tx = Flying light. |resskill_3_tx = Creation turn to ash. |resskill_4_tx = And the trap closes. |resskill_5_tx = Break! |resskill_6_tx = To nothing. |resskill_7_tx = To dust. |resliberation_1_tx = All kneel... the Waking Moon has risen! |resliberation_2_tx = By Sentinel's decree... the field is set. |resliberation_3_tx = At my coming, worlds arise. |resliberation_4_tx = Within this domain, I am the law. |resliberation_5_tx = Cities rise, infinite worlds tear. |resliberation_6_tx = All forms return to ruin! |introoutro_1_tx = Nexus turns, stars sink. |introoutro_2_tx = One will, infinite forms. |dodge_1_tx = Don't be so hasty. |dodgecounter_1_tx = A hair's breath. |hit_1_tx = Insolence... |hit_2_tx = ...Not without skill. |injured_1_tx = Oh dear, my hairpins! |injured_2_tx = A third of my power... is more than enough. |fallen_1_tx = This heart will not waver... |fallen_2_tx = I have... failed you... |fallen_3_tx = Arbiter... farewell... |esummon_1_tx = Come forth, little one. |etransform_1_tx = Not merely a fox. |enemynear_1_tx = What a generous reception. |glider_1_tx = ...Nothing compares to this mortal world. |sensor_1_tx = See? There's no hiding from me. |dash_1_tx = Fancy yourself able to keep up? |chest_1_tx = Oh, this one's a treasure. |chest_2_tx = This land knows to treat us well. |chest_3_tx = Does this please you? }} ==Change History== {{Change History|3.7}} ==Navigation== {{Resonator Navbox|type=voicelines}}
